description: Na₂NiFeF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-55°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.87 Å. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.95-1.99 Å. Ni is bonded to six F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Ni-F bond lengths. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Ni atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ni atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one Ni atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ni atoms.
